mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product_images WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND media_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY position ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_images (id, product_id, object_key, alt_text, role, position, media_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{productId}, #{objectKey}, #{altText}, #{role}::image_role, #{position}, #{mediaStatus}::media_status, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE product_images SET alt_text = #{altText}, role = #{role}::image_role, position = #{position}, media_status = #{mediaStatus}::media_status, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
